source.author: cic
source.text: quid, cum coram sumus et garrimus quicquid in buccam?
source.text_original: quid, cum coram sumus et garrimus quicquid in buccam?
source.text_english: What about when we are together face to face and chatter whatever comes into our mouths?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Haec ad breuem lucubratiunculam celeri sermone dictaui uolens desiderio postulantis satisfacere et quasi ad scholasticam materiam me exercens - eadem enim die mane pulsabat ostium, qui profecturus erat - simulque, ut ostenderem obtrectatoribus meis, quod et ego possim, quicquid uenerit in buccam, dicere.
reuse.text_original: Haec ad breuem lucubratiunculam celeri sermone dictaui uolens desiderio postulantis satisfacere et quasi ad scholasticam materiam me exercens - eadem enim die mane pulsabat ostium, qui profecturus erat - simulque, ut ostenderem obtrectatoribus meis, quod et ego possim, quicquid uenerit in buccam, dicere.
reuse.text_english: I dictated these things in quick speech for a brief little night’s work, wishing to satisfy the request of the one asking for it, and, as it were, exercising myself on a schoolroom topic—for on that very day, in the morning, the man who was about to depart was knocking at the door—and at the same time, in order to show my detractors that I too can say whatever comes to my lips.
